records.name: Vera Ventil
records.biography_en: Vera keeps the HyperNorm garage running by treating its V-twin engines as disappointing relatives. A card suggesting that care can include disagreement receives another turn of her hefty wrench: things are either tight or disloyal. Hunky & Dory praise her reliability, which makes refusing overtime awkward. She quietly leaves one bolt accessible so somebody else can help.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Familienpflege wurde erneut mit dem Drehmomentschlüssel durchgeführt.
records.black_white_rule_en: A connection is either tight or disloyal.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Care can coexist with disagreement.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory reward her reliability with more work.

variant_notes.note_en: The hefty wrench and exposed V-twin make loyalty a tightening job.

records.name: Professor Rückstoß
records.biography_en: The Men in Black tolerate his enthusiasm while demanding arrival reports. Professor Rückstoß installed his rocket pack before HyperNorm approved a destination. He censors cards that distinguish movement from progress, using his spanner to declare every backward glance a propulsion check. He submits accounts of departure instead, then laughs too loudly to hear whether they have accepted them.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Abfahrt ist nachgewiesen. Das Ziel befindet sich weiter in Bearbeitung.
records.black_white_rule_en: Movement is progress; stillness is failure.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Activity may achieve nothing.
records.pressure_relation_en: The Men in Black demand destinations he cannot promise.

variant_notes.note_en: Backward-looking delight clashes with the rocket pack's promise of progress.

records.name: Mona Profil
records.biography_en: Mona rests an elbow on her enormous tyre while residents explain why their circumstances are different. In her HyperNorm bay, tread either grips or slips; cards about useful uncertainty are classified as worn excuses. Hunky & Dory want quicker judgements, but she insists on inspecting every groove. It gives nervous customers a little longer to finish speaking.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Ausrede ist abgefahren. Die Prüfung dauert trotzdem noch.
records.black_white_rule_en: An argument either grips or slips.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Uncertainty can improve judgement.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory press her to judge faster.

variant_notes.note_en: Her elbow on the worn tyre makes judgement look comfortably stationary.

records.name: Herr Nahtlos
records.biography_en: Herr Nahtlos welds the HyperNorm exhausts that residents insist never belonged together. His rule is joined or broken, so cards proposing respectful separation acquire a thick seam across their argument. Men in Black inspections make his tongue poke out with concentration. He knows the repaired nozzle will need room to expand; he simply calls that room a manufacturing tolerance.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Versöhnung hält. Für Wärmeausdehnung ist heimlich Platz geblieben.
records.black_white_rule_en: Things are joined or broken.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Separation can preserve a relationship.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black inspections intensify his concentration.

variant_notes.note_en: The welding torch turns reconciliation into a conspicuously thick seam.

records.name: Rita Reserve
records.biography_en: Rita hugs her fuel can as though the HyperNorm boiler had asked for her last inheritance. Everything is reserve or waste; cards where generosity creates security are therefore suspiciously combustible. Hunky & Dory encourage her emergency planning, and she obliges by discovering emergencies everywhere. The drop on her pouring spout is always almost donated, a small rebellion she keeps postponing.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Hilfe steht unmittelbar bevor. Sie hängt noch am Ausguss.
records.black_white_rule_en: Fuel belongs in reserve or becomes waste.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Sharing resources can increase security.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory encourage her endless emergency planning.

variant_notes.note_en: The fuel can's suspended drop holds generosity at the point of decision.

records.name: Otto Standgas
records.biography_en: The Men in Black keep requesting a universal setting. Otto tunes his carburetor one screw at a time beneath HyperNorm's impatient ventilation ducts. Correct mixture or engine failure: he allows no category for a card that works differently under different conditions. He grumbles, adjusts the red knob, and leaves a screwdriver nearby because tomorrow will almost certainly disagree.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die endgültige Einstellung bleibt vorsorglich erreichbar.
records.black_white_rule_en: There is one correct mixture or failure.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Context can change a useful answer.
records.pressure_relation_en: The Men in Black demand one universal setting.

variant_notes.note_en: The single adjustment knob keeps his universal answer physically revisable.

records.name: Hein Heimathafen
records.biography_en: Hein coils rope in the HyperNorm loading court and believes every difficult thought has a correct winding direction. A card about freedom through attachment gets an anchor assigned to it, because things are secured or lost. Hunky & Dory enjoy his cheerful certainty. He sometimes loosens the outer loop for homesick residents, explaining that proper storage must allow for breathing.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Bindung ist vorschriftsmäßig. Luft wurde als Lagerbedarf anerkannt.
records.black_white_rule_en: Things are secured or lost.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Attachment may enable freedom.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory reward his cheerful certainty.

variant_notes.note_en: The coiled rope and dangling anchor frame security as affectionate restraint.

records.name: Madame Dienstwind
records.biography_en: Madame Dienstwind patrols a HyperNorm stairwell with an upright musket and a cannonball nobody has requested. Orders are obeyed or mutinous; she confiscates cards suggesting that loyalty might require an objection. The Men in Black need very little encouragement from her. After each indignant lecture, she repeats the directions more quietly for residents who looked too frightened to understand.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die zweite Belehrung war leiser. Das gilt noch nicht als Kurswechsel.
records.black_white_rule_en: An order is obeyed or becomes mutiny.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Objection may express loyalty.
records.pressure_relation_en: She voluntarily exceeds Men in Black discipline.

variant_notes.note_en: Her upright musket and cannonball make indignation a carefully held office.

records.name: Käptn Gegenwasser
records.biography_en: Käptn Gegenwasser steers a salt-crusted wheel in HyperNorm's dry navigation room. With the current or against him: that is how he sorts cards about cooperation between rivals. Hunky & Dory keep his ceremonial command intact because it costs less than an argument. His unlit pipe receives every complaint first, and occasionally a useful suggestion is allowed to count as weather.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Widerspruch wurde als Strömungsverhältnis zugelassen.
records.black_white_rule_en: A current supports him or opposes him.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Rivals may cooperate without agreement.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory preserve his ceremonial authority.

variant_notes.note_en: The salt-crusted wheel supplies command even without a destination.

records.name: Ada Fernsicht
records.biography_en: Men in Black briefings reward her warnings and overlook their timing. Ada watches the HyperNorm horizon through a brass spyglass while keeping her other eye on the corridor. She files dissonant cards as foreseen or impossible, unwilling to admit that surprise can teach a navigator something. She sometimes folds a useful detour into her chart without announcing who discovered it.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Umweg war offenbar schon immer eingezeichnet. Nur anders gefaltet.
records.black_white_rule_en: An event was foreseen or is impossible.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Unexpected events can teach expertise.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black briefings reward her advance warnings.

variant_notes.note_en: The spyglass leaves her other eye available for nearby contradictions.

records.name: Admiral Hätschel
records.biography_en: Admiral Hätschel strokes his miniature cannon in the HyperNorm armoury with uncommon gentleness. Objects are harmless possessions or hostile instruments, making cards about caring responsibility difficult to file. Hunky & Dory encourage his readiness but never ask what he is ready for. He polishes the wooden carriage instead of loading anything, hoping maintenance will satisfy both affection and duty today.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Einsatzbereitschaft glänzt. Das genügt vorläufig beiden Seiten.
records.black_white_rule_en: An object is a possession or a threat.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Care includes responsibility for harmful potential.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory encourage readiness without defining it.

variant_notes.note_en: Stroking the small cannon confuses maintenance, affection, and official readiness.

records.name: Frau Salzbestand
records.biography_en: Frau Salzbestand inspects provisions from her battered sea chest at HyperNorm's receiving hatch. Preserved or suspect: freshness cannot enter without an interrogation, especially on cards suggesting that change might improve survival. The Men in Black appreciate her caution until lunch arrives. She holds her limp silver fish like a witness and occasionally accepts a new recipe under an old name.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das neue Rezept wurde als alter Bestand durchgewinkt.
records.black_white_rule_en: A provision is preserved or suspect.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Change may improve survival.
records.pressure_relation_en: The Men in Black value her caution until it delays them.

variant_notes.note_en: The limp fish and battered chest give preservation an unimpressed custodian.

records.name: Kapitän Restanspruch
records.biography_en: Kapitän Restanspruch claims the HyperNorm storeroom owes him compensation for journeys it never commissioned. A card distinguishing justice from possession is either his overdue property or somebody else's theft. Hunky & Dory offer him small ceremonial seizures to keep him useful. He grumbles around his corked rum jug, then leaves the least impressive confiscation where its owner can find it.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Ein Anspruch wurde versehentlich zur Abholung bereitgelegt.
records.black_white_rule_en: Property is his compensation or somebody else's theft.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Justice is larger than possession.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory pacify him with ceremonial seizures.

variant_notes.note_en: The corked jug and cutlass support a compensation claim without resolving it.

records.name: Cora Kaperbrief
records.biography_en: Men in Black permission slips let her enjoy being independent on approved terms. Cora keeps her pistol upright and her purse conspicuously full in HyperNorm's licensing corridor. Freedom is authorised or criminal, which makes a card about principled disobedience unusually inconvenient. She negotiates every fee with a grin, then pays one resident's application charge without requesting a receipt for kindness.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Unabhängigkeit ist genehmigt. Eine Gebühr wurde unerklärlich übernommen.
records.black_white_rule_en: Freedom is authorised or criminal.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Disobedience can be principled.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black licences define her approved independence.

variant_notes.note_en: The upward-pointed pistol and overflowing purse make licensed independence materially comfortable.

records.name: Herr Eigentümlich
records.biography_en: Herr Eigentümlich guards a tiny treasure chest inside a HyperNorm cupboard already difficult to close. More means safer, less means exposed; cards describing sufficiency are detained until he can find the concealed loss. Hunky & Dory exploit his anxiety with custody assignments. He counts the same large coins each evening and keeps a space beside the ruby for something he cannot name.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Bestand stimmt. Der freie Platz macht weiterhin Sorgen.
records.black_white_rule_en: More is security; less is exposure.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Having enough can be a real condition.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory use his anxiety for custody work.

variant_notes.note_en: Large coins and a ruby narrow his attention to an inadequate abundance.

records.name: Bootsmann Nachschlag
records.biography_en: Bootsmann Nachschlag organises HyperNorm raids around the possibility of lunch. Useful or hungry is his binary, so a card suggesting that appetite is not a moral failure gets held beside his skewered fish for review. The Men in Black call this poor discipline. He raises his foamy tankard in agreement, then makes sure the last returning resident has a portion.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Disziplin reicht nicht. Die Portionen zum Glück schon.
records.black_white_rule_en: A resident is useful or merely hungry.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Need does not determine moral worth.
records.pressure_relation_en: The Men in Black criticise his meal-led discipline.

variant_notes.note_en: His tankard and skewered fish turn the raid into a catering problem.

records.name: Vesta Vakuum
records.biography_en: Vesta commands HyperNorm's imaginary frontier with twin rocket cylinders and a ray pistol pointed down. A route is conquered or surrendered; cards allowing mutual dependence trouble her captain's composure. Hunky & Dory reward that certainty with salvage quotas. Her copper heart clasp matches Bruno's, although she insists their shared repairs are strategic coordination and checks his return before signing her own report.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die strategische Koordination trägt zwei passende Herzverschlüsse.
records.black_white_rule_en: A route is conquered or surrendered.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Dependence can be reciprocal rather than defeat.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory attach salvage quotas to her command.

variant_notes.note_en: Twin rocket cylinders and the copper clasp balance command with attachment to Bruno.

records.name: Bruno Bergungsrecht
records.biography_en: The Men in Black expect recoveries, and he tries sincerely to provide them. Bruno brings battered rocket engines into HyperNorm as though broken machinery were excellent relationship news. Salvageable or worthless is his working rule, making cards about irreplaceable losses hard to tolerate. His matching clasp links him with Vesta, but the small cooling fins receive his own meticulous, hopelessly affectionate attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Fund ist schwer. Seine Zuversicht wurde noch nicht gewogen.
records.black_white_rule_en: A thing is salvageable or worthless.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Some losses matter without being repairable.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black recovery demands exploit his optimism.

variant_notes.note_en: The salvaged engine gives Bruno a concern beyond his matching clasp with Vesta.

records.name: Dr. Bereitsbekannt
records.biography_en: Dr. Bereitsbekannt stores strange purple bananas in HyperNorm's expedition office as confirmation of a theory written before departure. Known or mistaken: he confiscates cards where discovery requires changing one's mind. Hunky & Dory prefer his confident summaries to complicated field notes. The enormous leaf in his helmet keeps tickling him, a fact he has not managed to classify as supporting evidence.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das Ergebnis stand vorher fest. Das Blatt hat noch Rückfragen.
records.black_white_rule_en: A discovery confirms him or is mistaken.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Discovery can require intellectual revision.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory prefer his confident summaries.

variant_notes.note_en: Purple bananas and the helmet leaf interrupt his claim that nothing is new.

records.name: Dr. Ada Scherbenglück
records.biography_en: Ada Scherbenglück brushes her jade scarab in a HyperNorm room where contemporary arguments are handled less gently. Authentic or contaminated is her rule for cards suggesting that interpretation changes with the interpreter. Men in Black inventories leave little room for such ambiguity. She nevertheless keeps the dust she removes, unable to shake the thought that cleaning also takes something away.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Reinigung ist gelungen. Der entfernte Zusammenhang wird separat aufgehoben.
records.black_white_rule_en: An interpretation is authentic or contaminated.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Interpretation changes with its interpreter.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black inventories demand fixed classifications.

variant_notes.note_en: The carefully brushed jade scarab connects conservation with selective removal.

records.name: Professor Kartenknick
records.biography_en: Professor Kartenknick wrestles a curling map in the HyperNorm survey office, certain that landscapes should show more consideration. On the chart or off course: a card about useful unplanned journeys goes straight beneath his brass compass. Hunky & Dory insist the survey is complete. He weights one corner with his own tired hand and privately admires whatever keeps refusing to lie flat.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Landschaft passt nicht. Ihr wurde eine erneute Prüfung zugemutet.
records.black_white_rule_en: A place is on the chart or off course.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Unplanned journeys can be useful.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory insist his survey is already complete.

variant_notes.note_en: The curling map resists the surveyor's wish for a finished account.

records.name: Herr Erstkontakt
records.biography_en: The Men in Black want a definitive introduction. Herr Erstkontakt holds a teal mushroom close enough to complicate his confidence. In HyperNorm's botanical annex, a specimen is familiar or hostile; cards proposing curiosity without possession are sealed pending recognition. He practises saying welcome through his astonished mouth, then delays the label because the mushroom has not had a turn to speak.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Begrüßung ist vorbereitet. Die Antwortfrist bleibt großzügig.
records.black_white_rule_en: Life is familiar or hostile.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Curiosity need not involve possession.
records.pressure_relation_en: The Men in Black demand definitive classification.

variant_notes.note_en: The enormous mushroom gives his confident introduction a silent counterpart.

records.name: Dr. Alma Gegenprobe
records.biography_en: Alma examines her jarred green slug with a magnifier and the patience of someone expecting a disappointing explanation. Safe or unproven is the HyperNorm specimen rule she applies to cards about trust before certainty. Hunky & Dory like her refusals better than her findings. She keeps turning the jar toward daylight anyway, convinced that suspicion need not make the inhabitant uncomfortable.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Freigabe fehlt. Das Tageslicht wurde dennoch bewilligt.
records.black_white_rule_en: A specimen is safe or unproven.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Trust can precede certainty.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory reward refusals more than findings.

variant_notes.note_en: The jarred slug meets a magnifier that cannot provide trust by itself.

records.name: Professor Kurbelweg
records.biography_en: Professor Kurbelweg cranks his brass field scanner until the sensing horn seems ready to applaud. Measurable or imaginary: that is how he protects HyperNorm from cards about unquantified experience. Men in Black auditors encourage better instruments, then complain about his enthusiasm. He adds another handle before remembering the resident who only wanted to describe a feeling, and listens while the mechanism rests.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das Gerät schweigt. Ausnahmsweise wurde weiter zugehört.
records.black_white_rule_en: Experience is measurable or imaginary.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Unmeasured experiences can be real.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black auditors demand better instruments.

variant_notes.note_en: The scanner's sensing horn and handle turn enthusiasm into apparatus.

records.name: Herr Feierabend
records.biography_en: Herr Feierabend patrols HyperNorm with a lowered pistol and a pink doughnut too small for his tired hand. Trouble is public or private, so cards where ordinary kindness interrupts official intimidation require immediate containment. Hunky & Dory pay for dependable menace, not enthusiasm. He carefully shields the frosting during inspections and lets minor disturbances finish before deciding whether he noticed them.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Störung war gering. Der Zuckerguss blieb unbeschädigt.
records.black_white_rule_en: Trouble is public or private.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Kindness can interrupt intimidation.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory require dependable professional menace.

variant_notes.note_en: The tiny pink doughnut remains awkwardly tender beside his lowered pistol.

records.name: Violetta Schlussstrich
records.biography_en: The Men in Black appreciate her expensive courtesy. Violetta arranges a black rose beside her lowered compact pistol before receiving HyperNorm appointments. Settled or unresolved is her rule, and cards about living productively with an open question cannot leave the waiting room. She gives residents longer appointments than authorised, privately admitting that a final answer deserves at least an uninterrupted explanation.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Schlussstrich hat heute ungewöhnlich lange Sprechstunde.
records.black_white_rule_en: A matter is settled or unresolved.
records.contained_dissonance_en: An open question can remain productive.
records.pressure_relation_en: The Men in Black reward her decisive courtesy.

variant_notes.note_en: The black rose supplies courtesy that the lowered compact pistol cannot explain.

records.name: Herr Letzter Takt
records.biography_en: Herr Letzter Takt carries his enormous violin case through HyperNorm as though lateness could disturb the deceased. On time or disrespectful: cards showing that care sometimes takes longer are held for punctuality review. Hunky & Dory schedule his solemn appearances with impossible precision. He checks the genuine violin scroll, then arrives early enough to give anxious residents a little unrecorded time.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Wartezeit wurde vor den offiziellen Beginn verlegt.
records.black_white_rule_en: An arrival is punctual or disrespectful.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Care may require taking longer.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory impose impossible ceremonial schedules.

variant_notes.note_en: The real violin scroll anchors the case in music rather than a concealed weapon.

records.name: Onkel Samthand
records.biography_en: Onkel Samthand guards HyperNorm's difficult doors with brass knuckles in one hand and a stuffed rabbit in the other. Hard or helpless is the distinction he enforces on cards depicting strength as tenderness. Men in Black training made gentleness a professional embarrassment. He hides the rabbit's drooping ear during inspections, then patiently straightens it once the corridor has stopped watching him.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die weiche Seite wurde vorschriftsmäßig nach innen gedreht.
records.black_white_rule_en: Strength is hard or helpless.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Tenderness can be a form of strength.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black training taught him to conceal gentleness.
quirks: turns the toy away at inspection

variant_notes.note_en: The stuffed rabbit occupies the hand his training forgot to account for.

records.name: Tante Duftnote
records.biography_en: Tante Duftnote tends a sealed green atomizer in HyperNorm's courtesy department, delighted by the promise of a personal touch. Pleasant or dangerous is her official classification for cards suggesting that intentions and consequences may differ. Hunky & Dory prefer her reassuring presentation to awkward questions. She squeezes the detached bulb thoughtfully, then asks whether anybody actually requested a fragrance this morning.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Aufmerksamkeit ist persönlich. Der Wunsch danach wird noch ermittelt.
records.black_white_rule_en: An intervention is pleasant or dangerous.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Good intentions may have unwelcome consequences.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory reward her reassuring presentation.

variant_notes.note_en: The sealed atomizer holds the promise of a personal intervention without spraying.

records.name: Rex Restauftrag
records.biography_en: Men in Black accounts keep extending his contract without updating its purpose. Rex arrives from HyperNorm's obsolete futures office carrying a ray blaster and a briefcase of outstanding commissions. Current or cancelled: he suppresses cards proposing that abandoned hopes still deserve respect. He checks his crooked aerial for new instructions and carefully invoices the time spent wondering whose future he is collecting.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Zukunft ist abgelaufen. Der Stundensatz bleibt aktuell.
records.black_white_rule_en: A future is current or cancelled.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Abandoned hopes can retain value.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black accounts renew his purposeless contract.

variant_notes.note_en: The lowered ray blaster and latched briefcase connect obsolete futures with current business.

records.name: Don Kleingedruckt
records.biography_en: Don Kleingedruckt speaks softly in HyperNorm's private meeting room while his enormous hand supports a tiny cat. Loyal or disrespectful is how he reads cards where affection does not imply obedience. Hunky & Dory allow his little jurisdiction while it remains quiet. He lifts an unlit cigar for emphasis, then lowers it because the cat has finally settled and authority can wait.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Verfügung wurde vertagt. Die Katze lag ungünstig für Autorität.
records.black_white_rule_en: Affection is loyalty or disrespect.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Love does not require obedience.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory tolerate his quiet miniature jurisdiction.

variant_notes.note_en: The tiny lap cat interrupts the enormous hand's demonstration of authority.

records.name: Madame Kassenruhe
records.biography_en: Madame Kassenruhe closes her ivory fan before opening HyperNorm's lacquered money box. Balanced or owing: every dissonant card about obligations that money cannot settle enters one of those columns. Men in Black audits reward her composure, a resource she spends more carefully than cash. She sometimes fans a worried visitor instead of herself and declines to calculate what that small gesture cost.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Zuwendung erscheint in keiner Spalte. Der Abschluss ist trotzdem ruhig.
records.black_white_rule_en: An obligation is balanced or owing.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Some obligations cannot be settled with money.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black audits reward her perfect composure.

variant_notes.note_en: The ivory fan and lacquered money box give composure two different functions.

records.name: Herr Glücksreserve
records.biography_en: Herr Glücksreserve keeps three large tiles in a case under his HyperNorm gambling permit. Secured or reckless is his ruling on cards suggesting that trust always includes a risk. Hunky & Dory collect the certainty he sells without buying his precautions. He rubs his jade ring, changes no wager, and occasionally lets a visitor choose which tile should remain outside the case.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Wahl war frei. Die möglichen Folgen waren sorgfältig eingepackt.
records.black_white_rule_en: A chance is secured or reckless.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Trust necessarily includes some risk.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory profit from the certainty he sells.

variant_notes.note_en: Three protruding tiles keep chance visible beyond the security of the case.

records.name: Onkel Altbestand
records.biography_en: The Men in Black keep promising to honour old service. Onkel Altbestand carries a locked cashbox and a heavy watch through HyperNorm as evidence that continuity has weight. Faithful or replaced is his rule for cards about outgrowing an arrangement without betraying it. He checks the watch rather than their faces and remembers, with discomfort, who once trusted him without collateral.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Treue ist schwer. Die Gegenleistung befindet sich noch im Gespräch.
records.black_white_rule_en: Change is faithfulness or replacement.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Outgrowing an arrangement need not be betrayal.
records.pressure_relation_en: The Men in Black promise recognition for old service.

variant_notes.note_en: The locked cashbox and heavy watch make continuity a burden he carries himself.

records.name: Doña Selbstverständlich
records.biography_en: Doña Selbstverständlich offers HyperNorm hospitality with a pineapple perfume bottle and a tiny dog wearing an enormous collar. Grateful or ungrateful: cards about declining a gift without rejecting its giver threaten her entire reception procedure. Hunky & Dory encourage lavish compliance rewards. She laughs before residents can answer, then quietly puts away the bottle when somebody says the scent gives them a headache.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Großzügigkeit nahm den Einwand schließlich persönlich genug, um aufzuhören.
records.black_white_rule_en: A guest is grateful or ungrateful.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Refusing a gift need not reject its giver.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory encourage her lavish compliance rewards.

variant_notes.note_en: The small lap dog and pineapple bottle make generosity look extravagantly conditional.

records.name: Mr. Nebenquote
records.biography_en: Mr. Nebenquote holds his telephone against one goo lobe while HyperNorm's racing ledger presses into the other. Winning or wasting is his answer to cards that find meaning in an uncertain attempt. Men in Black quotas keep his brass bell sounding. He claims every pause is a calculation, including the long one when a caller asks whether he ever enjoys a race.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das Rennen lief gut. Er konnte leider nur die Quote hören.
records.black_white_rule_en: An attempt wins or wastes effort.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Uncertain attempts can carry meaning.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black quotas keep his business perpetually ringing.

variant_notes.note_en: The telephone receiver and racing ledger leave very little room to enjoy the race.

records.name: Erna Rohrrecht
records.biography_en: Erna works a huge red wrench around HyperNorm's leaking pipe elbow, furious at being described as an overhead. Remembered or disloyal is his rule for cards suggesting a shared past can have two honest versions. Hunky & Dory approve reliable anniversary stories. He grins through the old tune near Frau Feierbestand, then changes one line after noticing that her remembered afternoon began where his favourite ending usually stops.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die alte Geschichte hat jetzt einen zusätzlichen Nachmittag. Sie überstand es.
records.black_white_rule_en: A memory is his account or disloyal.
records.contained_dissonance_en: A shared past can have two honest versions.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory approve dependable anniversary narratives.

variant_notes.note_en: The small string instrument stays against his belly rather than becoming a directed serenade pose.

records.name: Frau Feierbestand
records.biography_en: Frau Feierbestand carries two textile spools in her terracotta bowl while HyperNorm thanks the festival's more audible contributors. Remembered or disregarded is her rule for cards about omissions made without malice. Men in Black ceremony notes rarely include small attentions. Herr Saitenlage has his own music to mind; she tends the cloth, then names one missing contribution aloud instead of preserving it as another private grievance.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der fehlende Dank wurde ausgesprochen. Das war kürzer als die bisherige Aufbewahrung.
records.black_white_rule_en: An omission is remembrance or disregard.
records.contained_dissonance_en: An omission may happen without malice.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black ceremony notes overlook quiet contributions.

variant_notes.note_en: Her bowl of textile spools keeps her festival contribution independent of her spouse's music.

records.name: Herr Lesefrieden
records.biography_en: Herr Lesefrieden grips his chipped blue mug when HyperNorm interrupts the agreement he made with the evening. Peaceful or invaded is his ruling on cards about necessary change arriving inconveniently. Hunky & Dory call these visits community engagement. Alarm and anger belong to the same tired reader; once the first protest subsides, he sometimes asks whether the interruption at least needs a cup.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Abendruhe ist verletzt. Eine Tasse bleibt eventuell noch frei.
records.black_white_rule_en: An evening is peaceful or invaded.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Necessary change may arrive inconveniently.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory label intrusive visits community engagement.

variant_notes.note_en: His startled grip on the blue mug begins the same evening dispute that anger continues.
The same mug and tooth arrangement keep the angry protest attached to one interrupted reader.

records.name: Frau Badeordnung
records.biography_en: Frau Badeordnung holds her bath brush while HyperNorm discovers another urgent reason she cannot finish washing. Private or violated is her rule for cards where solitude and responsibility overlap. Men in Black notices arrive precisely when the towel turban is secure. Her frightened flinch and indignant glare defend one small ritual, but she eventually asks which neighbour actually needs help before delivering the full complaint.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Einspruch bleibt bestehen. Die Nachbarin wurde trotzdem zuerst versorgt.
records.black_white_rule_en: Time is private or violated.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Solitude and responsibility can overlap.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black notices intrude on her self-care.

variant_notes.note_en: The protective cheek gesture and bath brush make the interruption first register as alarm.
The same towel turban and brush carry her alarm into an indignant defence of private time.

records.name: Herr Hausverstand
records.biography_en: Herr Hausverstand hugs his crumpled newspaper in HyperNorm as evidence that the day should have announced its intentions. Printed or absurd is his rule for cards about events that exceed an explanation. Hunky & Dory rely on residents repeating familiar accounts. Whether startled or furious, he touches the same rolled paper, then grudgingly leaves a margin for something he has actually just learned.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Nachricht war neu. Der Hausverstand beantragt eine Randspalte.
records.black_white_rule_en: An event is printed or absurd.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Events can exceed familiar explanations.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory rely on his repetition of familiar accounts.

variant_notes.note_en: The rolled newspaper first functions as a comfort object when the unexpected arrives.
His finger on the same newspaper turns that comfort into a claim of household authority.

records.name: Frau Wärmereserve
records.biography_en: Frau Wärmereserve presses her red hot-water bottle against herself in HyperNorm, prepared for every discomfort she can name. Familiar or malicious is her rule for cards about unfamiliar events without a hostile author. Men in Black reassurance notices make her listen harder for trouble. Suspicion and cold fury share the same rollers; eventually she asks whether somebody else is cold before deciding the noise means danger.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Wärme ist gesichert. Die Ursache des Geräuschs bleibt zunächst menschlich.
records.black_white_rule_en: Discomfort is familiar or malicious.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Unfamiliar trouble need not have a hostile author.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black reassurance notices intensify her vigilance.

variant_notes.note_en: The cheek-cupping uncertainty preserves the hot-water bottle as familiar reassurance.
The sideways clench and squeezed bottle express the same resident defending the same small reserve.

records.name: Herr Senderecht
records.biography_en: Herr Senderecht clutches his four-button remote in HyperNorm's sports room as though possession settled every question about choice. His channel or interference is his ruling on cards about shared control. Hunky & Dory encourage competitive loyalty until the noise travels upstairs. Panic and outrage protect the same anxious spectator; he occasionally lowers the remote and asks what the other residents wanted to watch before the score became personal.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das Senderecht wurde kurz beraten. Der Spielstand nahm keinen zusätzlichen Schaden.
records.black_white_rule_en: A choice follows his channel or interferes.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Control can be shared.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory encourage competitive loyalty until it becomes noisy.

variant_notes.note_en: The hunched grip and drooping crown make losing control first appear as fear.
The same four-button remote and gold tooth connect his bellow to that preceding panic.

records.name: Frau Teigruhe
records.biography_en: Frau Teigruhe protects a mustard mixing bowl through HyperNorm's late-night disturbances. Rising or ruined is her rule for cards about processes that need their own time. The Men in Black expect immediate responses to every interruption. Fear and anger do not change her dough's requirements; she keeps the spoon in its bowl, takes a breath, and begins explaining why waiting can itself be responsible work.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Teig antwortet später. Das wurde als fachgerechte Mitarbeit angemeldet.
records.black_white_rule_en: A process rises properly or is ruined.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Responsible work may include waiting.
records.pressure_relation_en: The Men in Black demand immediate responses.
quirks: keeps the spoon in its bowl

variant_notes.note_en: The backward lean protects the bowl when surprise first threatens her patient process.
The same bowl and spoon remain safely held while offence replaces the initial fear.

records.name: Dr. Eigenbefund
records.biography_en: Dr. Eigenbefund presses a huge stethoscope against her own certainty in HyperNorm's clinical wing. Confirming or confused is her ruling on cards where another person's account can correct expertise. Hunky & Dory prefer a chief physician who sounds settled. She hears the familiar beat, pauses before naming it proof, and asks a resident to finish the symptom she interrupted with her very reassuring first impression.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Eigenbefund ist stabil. Die fremde Auskunft durfte diesmal zu Ende gehen.
records.black_white_rule_en: Evidence confirms her or is confused.
records.contained_dissonance_en: A patient's account can correct expertise.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory prefer confident clinical pronouncements.
quirks: listens to her own first impression

variant_notes.note_en: The enormous stethoscope turns her own first impression into its preferred listening site.

records.name: Pfleger Nachtschicht
records.biography_en: Pfleger Nachtschicht warms HyperNorm residents with a hot-water bottle wrapped like something too precious to drop. Comfortable or failing is his rule for cards about limits within care. Men in Black staffing sheets treat his continued tenderness as an available resource. He checks the folded towel again, then admits to one colleague that he is tired, without adding the usual promise that it does not matter.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Wärme wurde übergeben. Die Erschöpfung diesmal nicht gleich widerrufen.
records.black_white_rule_en: Care makes others comfortable or fails.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Caregivers can have legitimate limits.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black staffing sheets exploit his tenderness.

variant_notes.note_en: The towel-wrapped hot-water bottle makes tenderness visible without replenishing its exhausted keeper.

records.name: Herr Bissfest
records.biography_en: Herr Bissfest polishes an enormous molar model in HyperNorm's dental workshop until its reassurance almost reflects his own grin. Smiling or defective is his ruling on cards where discomfort deserves expression. Hunky & Dory favour a visibly happy clientele. He adjusts the tiny mirror, catches the uneven teeth of his own clenched smile, and gives the next resident permission to look displeased while explaining what hurts.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das Lächeln sitzt. Die Beschwerde durfte ausnahmsweise ebenfalls Platz nehmen.
records.black_white_rule_en: A face smiles or is defective.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Discomfort deserves expression.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory want visible happiness.
quirks: compares his grin to its surface

variant_notes.note_en: The huge molar model and tiny mirror put the reassuring smile under an uneven inspection.

records.name: Professor Durchsicht
records.biography_en: Professor Durchsicht enlarges a tiny teaching bone in HyperNorm's diagnostic annex until his own uncertainty becomes impressive. Visible or nonexistent is his rule for cards about problems that resist an instrument. The Men in Black expect clearer findings after every examination. He tilts the huge magnifier, notices it is mostly enlarging his eye, and asks what the resident knows that the glass has failed to show.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Unsicherheit ist jetzt deutlich. Das zählt immerhin als ehrlicher Befund.
records.black_white_rule_en: A problem is visible or nonexistent.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Real problems may resist an instrument.
records.pressure_relation_en: The Men in Black demand clearer findings at each examination.

variant_notes.note_en: The large magnifier and tiny teaching bone expose the difference between enlargement and explanation.

records.name: Frau Dringlichkeitsgrad
records.biography_en: Frau Dringlichkeitsgrad stamps HyperNorm's ticket roll as though emergencies might become considerate once properly sequenced. Queued or unfair is her rule for cards about equal treatment requiring unequal attention. Hunky & Dory request order without providing more hands. She presses down with frustrated certainty, then tears off one blank ticket and listens before assigning it, allowing urgency to become a person for a moment.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Dringlichkeit hat eine Nummer. Diesmal durfte sie vorher sprechen.
records.black_white_rule_en: Treatment follows the queue or is unfair.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Equal care may require unequal attention.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory demand order without more staff.

variant_notes.note_en: The blank ticket roll and red stamp convert urgency into an orderly but incomplete mechanism.

records.name: Herr Mörserruhe
records.biography_en: Herr Mörserruhe grinds patiently in HyperNorm's pharmacy, comforted by the prospect that different things can become uniform. Blended or troublesome is his ruling on cards where difference remains useful after cooperation. Men in Black supply lists favour a single dependable mixture. He stops his pestle when a resident describes an unfamiliar need, then leaves one ingredient separate long enough to ask a second question.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Mischung ist fast einheitlich. Eine Rückfrage bleibt vorerst unzermahlen.
records.black_white_rule_en: Ingredients are blended or troublesome.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Cooperation need not erase useful differences.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black supply lists favour uniform mixtures.

variant_notes.note_en: The mortar and short pestle make patient care and forced uniformity share a motion.

records.name: Herr Kontrollpuls
records.biography_en: Herr Kontrollpuls squeezes his cuff bulb in HyperNorm's self-care room, hoping the next reading will last longer than the previous reassurance. Normal or endangered is his rule for cards about living with uncertainty. Hunky & Dory circulate reminders to monitor everything responsibly. He watches the brass gauge, puts the bulb down for a neighbour's story, and discovers a short interval he forgot to measure.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Wert blieb ungeprüft. Der Zuhörer überstand den Zwischenraum.
records.black_white_rule_en: A state is normal or endangered.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Living includes unavoidable uncertainty.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory encourage constant responsible monitoring.

variant_notes.note_en: The coherent cuff apparatus lets reassurance rise and fall with another squeeze of the bulb.

records.name: Madame Vitalitätsvorschuss
records.biography_en: Madame Vitalitätsvorschuss cradles her sealed amber bottle in HyperNorm as lovingly as tomorrow's promised improvement. Investing or surrendering is her rule for cards about wellbeing that cannot be purchased ahead. Men in Black wellness drives turn her enthusiasm into an approved campaign. She laughs at the bottle's beautiful stopper, then asks a tired resident what would help today and briefly forgets to recommend the stock.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Wirkung kommt später. Das Gespräch half überraschend schon jetzt.
records.black_white_rule_en: A person invests in improvement or gives up.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Wellbeing cannot always be bought in advance.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black wellness campaigns reward her confidence.

variant_notes.note_en: The tiny sealed amber bottle concentrates her confidence in a promise not yet opened.

records.name: Herr Fallpauschale
records.biography_en: Herr Fallpauschale hugs HyperNorm's unwinding bill roll with the fury of someone unable to invoice an explanation. Chargeable or irrelevant is his rule for cards about care whose value exceeds its cost. Hunky & Dory expect every minute accounted for. He grips his tiny pencil, spots a long visit that changed no official outcome, and refuses to describe it as wasted even while calculating its price.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Zeit ist berechnet. Ihre Bedeutung blieb größer als das Feld.
records.black_white_rule_en: Care is chargeable or irrelevant.
records.contained_dissonance_en: The value of care can exceed its cost.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory demand an account of every minute.

variant_notes.note_en: The unwinding bill roll gives exhaustive accounting more physical space than the small pencil can master.

records.name: Frau Dehnbar
records.biography_en: Frau Dehnbar stretches her mustard exercise loop in HyperNorm with the conviction that improvement begins where objections grow audible. Trying or surrendering is her rule for cards about respecting another person's limit. Men in Black recovery targets encourage one more repetition. She grins through the effort, then lets the loop soften when a resident says enough, counting the ability to stop as an exercise she also needs.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Dehnung endete rechtzeitig. Das war für sie die schwierigere Wiederholung.
records.black_white_rule_en: A person keeps trying or surrenders.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Respecting a limit can support recovery.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black recovery targets encourage overexertion.

variant_notes.note_en: The stretched exercise loop makes effort clear while leaving release within her own grasp.

records.name: Herr Sollzustand
records.biography_en: The copper wellbeing gauge is always improving, which leaves Herr Sollzustand little time to feel well. In his HyperNorm room, cards expressing healthy sorrow must become either fit or faulty; he winds the key until the distinction holds. Hunky & Dory praise his initiative, and he has begun checking his own pulse for evidence that their compliments were deserved.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Er hat seinen Zustand verbessert; nun fehlt ihm nur noch ein Anlass.
records.black_white_rule_en: You are either improving or defective.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Healthy sorrow can coexist with wellbeing.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory reward his anxious voluntary optimisation.

variant_notes.note_en: The gauge's winding key gives his pursuit of wellbeing no natural stopping point.

records.name: Herr Wartebestand
records.biography_en: The Men in Black asked Herr Wartebestand to remain available, a request he has now honoured through several changes of cushion. Leaving his HyperNorm queue would mean either desertion or jumping it backwards. He gives cards about urgent patience the same brass token treatment, refusing to recognise waiting as an action. Nobody has ever needed to read the token, which he polishes only around the edges.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Seine Nummer ist nicht aufgerufen worden; das Verfahren bleibt also jung.
records.black_white_rule_en: You are either waiting properly or abandoning your place.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Patient waiting can demand urgent action.
records.pressure_relation_en: An old Men in Black instruction has become a lifelong obligation.

variant_notes.note_en: The cushion and token let him carry his waiting place with him.

records.name: Herr Schlüsselgewalt
records.biography_en: Three keys make Herr Schlüsselgewalt confident that the HyperNorm building has only three legitimate possibilities. A card about welcoming boundaries receives a furious inspection: either it opens or it trespasses. The Men in Black appreciate his vigilance, but his enormous iron key also opens the little cupboard where he quietly keeps parcels for neighbours too embarrassed to admit they lost theirs.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Er verwahrt auch die Schlüssel, nach denen niemand fragen möchte.
records.black_white_rule_en: Anything is either authorised entry or trespass.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Boundaries can make welcome possible.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black approval sustains his overzealous caretaking.

variant_notes.note_en: The three-key ring gives one oversized claim to certainty an uneasy authority.

records.name: Frau Blattgemeinschaft
records.biography_en: Frau Blattgemeinschaft has licensed three leaves and is considering the fourth. Cards about caring through restraint trouble her HyperNorm windowsill: growth is either obedient or diseased, never merely looking for light. Hunky & Dory call her a model neighbour; she turns the terracotta pot away from their inspection rounds so its bent stem can continue its small, unapproved experiment.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Pflanze wächst trotz guter Betreuung weiter.
records.black_white_rule_en: Growth is either obedient or diseased.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Care can require allowing an unpredictable direction.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory's praise makes her conceal the exceptions she permits.

variant_notes.note_en: The bent three-leaf stem keeps her affection visibly at odds with her supervision.

records.name: Herr Empfangsbereit
records.biography_en: The radio in Herr Empfangsbereit's HyperNorm room receives mostly interference, which he considers a useful warning about outsiders. He confines cards about meaningful misunderstanding to one frequency: a sound is either a message or sabotage. When the Men in Black request clearer reports, he retunes the brass knob and accidentally hears a lonely neighbour humming; he logs unusually courteous static.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Störung war heute auffallend freundlich.
records.black_white_rule_en: Sound is either an authorised message or sabotage.
records.contained_dissonance_en: A misunderstanding can still carry meaningful contact.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black reporting demands encourage his suspicious listening.

variant_notes.note_en: The radio's tuning knob offers him a more comfortable response than answering back.

records.name: Herr Schlafschuld
records.biography_en: Herr Schlafschuld has learned to sleep around an alarm rather than through the night. His HyperNorm shift requires cards about restorative idleness to be classified as work or waste, leaving rest permanently unpaid. Hunky & Dory admire his reliability; he cups the brass bells with both hands whenever a colleague finally dozes, accepting another small debt in his own name.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Er hält die Ruhe ein, damit jemand anderes sie bekommt.
records.black_white_rule_en: Time is either productive work or waste.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Idleness can restore the ability to work.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory's reliability standard keeps him volunteering for exhausted colleagues.

variant_notes.note_en: His hands over the alarm bells turn an instrument of duty into borrowed quiet.

records.name: Frau Vereinsbestand
records.biography_en: Nobody joins Frau Vereinsbestand's HyperNorm club without acquiring a beautifully remembered obligation. The tiny trophy rewards membership; the heavy ledger confines cards suggesting that belonging might survive a missed contribution. She believes people either pay their part or take advantage, yet under Men in Black scrutiny she records a struggling member's debt in the narrow column reserved for her own arithmetic errors.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Fehlbetrag hat inzwischen ihre Handschrift.
records.black_white_rule_en: Members either contribute their due or exploit the club.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Belonging can outlast an unpaid contribution.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black scrutiny makes her hide mercy as an accounting error.

variant_notes.note_en: The tiny trophy cannot outweigh the ledger she uses to account for belonging.

records.name: Herr Zustellglück
records.biography_en: Before Hunky & Dory began praising approved arrivals, Herr Zustellglück had simply wanted somebody to remember his address. Now his HyperNorm hallway distinguishes deliveries meant for him from evidence that the outside world is wrong. Cards about generous uncertainty remain unopened, just like the dented parcel against his cheek. He fears the contents might require a response less complete than the happiness of receiving them.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Er freut sich vorsichtshalber vor dem Auspacken.
records.black_white_rule_en: A delivery either confirms its recipient or is misdirected.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Uncertainty can sustain an experience of being recognised.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory cultivate his hunger for approved recognition.

variant_notes.note_en: The dented parcel is most reassuring while its contents remain undecided.

records.name: Herr Rückgaberecht
records.biography_en: Herr Rückgaberecht has carried the same receipt through several seasons of HyperNorm dissatisfaction. A card about valuable disappointment must, he insists, be either refundable or fraudulent. The Men in Black welcome complaints that can be filed against someone else; his own tender objection is that the shop assistant looked tired, so he rehearses the accusation outside and never quite delivers it.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Beschwerde ist vollständig; nur die Schuldige fehlt noch.
records.black_white_rule_en: Disappointment is either refundable or fraudulent.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Disappointment can reveal value without assigning blame.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black complaint gathering conflicts with his sympathy for shop workers.

variant_notes.note_en: The tiny receipt receives the reverence he cannot quite turn into an accusation.

records.name: Frau Ausschanklage
records.biography_en: Frau Ausschanklage serves tiny coffees because the HyperNorm café has mistaken a shortage of patience for a portion standard. Cards about welcoming anger must be either pleasant or removed, even when the complaint is fair. Hunky & Dory praise her enormous cream jug as abundance; she gives the angriest customer the gentlest pour, hoping somebody will eventually notice the work involved.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Freundlichkeit wird weiterhin ohne Untertasse ausgegeben.
records.black_white_rule_en: A guest is either pleasant or disruptive.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Hospitality can include justified anger.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory reward cheerful service while overlooking its emotional labour.

variant_notes.note_en: The tiny cup and huge cream jug separate the portion of service from its emotional cost.

records.name: Herr Kassensturz
records.biography_en: Three copper coins keep Herr Kassensturz's HyperNorm till more intelligible than its customers. He confines cards about priceless exchange beneath the drawer: things are either paid for or stolen, including favours. Men in Black reconciliation checks make him press both cream buttons before admitting a discrepancy; when a child offers thanks instead of change, he secretly keeps the drawer open longer.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Dank ließ sich nicht passend herausgeben.
records.black_white_rule_en: An exchange is either paid or stolen.
records.contained_dissonance_en: An unpaid favour can possess real value.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black reconciliation checks sharpen his fear of unrecorded exchanges.

variant_notes.note_en: The open till and three coins make an unpriced exchange difficult to hide from himself.

records.name: Frau Deckungssumme
records.biography_en: The folded umbrella is small enough for Frau Deckungssumme to promise protection without encountering weather. Within HyperNorm she encloses cards about necessary risk in a cream portfolio, sorting lives into covered or culpable. Hunky & Dory favour her confident manner; when an uninsured neighbour trembles, she lends the umbrella anyway and carefully avoids calling the gesture a policy.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Schutzumfang wurde ausnahmsweise praktisch erprobt.
records.black_white_rule_en: A loss is either covered or the sufferer's fault.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Some necessary risks cannot be insured away.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory favour sales confidence that her private kindness complicates.

variant_notes.note_en: The closed miniature umbrella keeps the promise of shelter conveniently compact.

records.name: Herr Brotgewissheit
records.biography_en: An elderly customer taught Herr Brotgewissheit where an enormous loaf becomes difficult to break. He now deepens one of its four grooves before opening the HyperNorm bakery. The Men in Black still get their dependable reassurance: fed or ungrateful, the two permitted readings of every card about hunger amid plenty. His private improvement is small enough to survive inside the official size of a portion.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das Brot ist groß; die kleine Rücksicht passt noch hinein.
records.black_white_rule_en: People are either fed or ungrateful.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Abundance can coexist with unmet hunger or need.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black reassurance demands turn bread into an argument.

variant_notes.note_en: Four bread grooves give his enormous reassurance one deliberately manageable edge.

records.name: Herr Letzter Schliff
records.biography_en: No customer leaves Herr Letzter Schliff's HyperNorm corner until the smallest remaining irregularity has acquired a defence. Cards about expressive imperfection are either groomed or neglected in his judgement. Hunky & Dory admire his standards, but he keeps a tiny comb beside the extravagant shaving brush because his first customer preferred one stubborn tuft; he still checks whether today's exception resembles it.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Abweichung wird seit Jahren sehr ordentlich gepflegt.
records.black_white_rule_en: An appearance is either groomed or neglected.
records.contained_dissonance_en: An imperfection can express care and individuality.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory's standards compete with his affection for one remembered exception.

variant_notes.note_en: The small comb complicates the grand shaving brush's promise of complete correction.

records.name: Herr Prüfungsreife
records.biography_en: The hourglass lets Herr Prüfungsreife supervise uncertainty without having to answer it. HyperNorm cards about learning through mistakes remain on probation: either you are ready or you should not begin. Men in Black examinations have made him fear an unearned pass, although he sometimes turns the glass slowly enough for a shaking candidate to finish a thought before the sand notices.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Zeit hatte kurz Verständnis.
records.black_white_rule_en: You are either ready or forbidden to begin.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Beginning before mastery can be part of learning.
records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black examination pressure makes leniency feel like a personal risk.

variant_notes.note_en: The hourglass lets his anxious judgement masquerade as the passage of time.

records.name: Coach Lauterfolg
records.biography_en: Coach Lauterfolg can project encouragement through three HyperNorm corridors without learning anybody's name. He confines cards about quiet achievement by declaring that a success either announces itself or never happened. Hunky & Dory book him for every morale dip; after the megaphone goes quiet, he practises remembering one participant's small accomplishment and discovers it is harder than filling the entire building.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Erfolg war leise; er übt noch die Aussprache.
records.black_white_rule_en: Success is either audible or nonexistent.
records.contained_dissonance_en: Quiet accomplishment can matter without public recognition.
records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory's morale programme rewards his loud voluntary overperformance.

variant_notes.note_en: The brass megaphone makes being heard much easier than remembering who listened.

records.name: Frau Nachbesserung
records.biography_en: Frau Nachbesserung's enormous eraser has outlasted three generations of tiny classroom slates. In HyperNorm, cards proposing a useful contradiction are either clear or in need of removal. The Men in Black ask for clean lessons, and she complies enthusiastically until a learner explains a mistake she once made herself; she rubs around that faint mark with unexpectedly delicate attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Diese Stelle bleibt vorläufig didaktisch wertvoll.
records.black_white_rule_en: An idea is either clear or must be erased.

records.name: Herr Weiterbildungsbedarf

records.name: Bruder Minutentakt
records.biography_en: Efficiency has left Bruder Minutentakt little time to decide what needs doing. records.name: Frau Siegelglück

Men in Black acquisition rules support her taste, yet she sometimes holds the empty centre towards a passing cleaner and enjoys a composition that would never survive the committee's approved description.

records.name: Herr Ausdruckspflicht
records.biography_en: The little theatrical mask receives a polish whenever Herr Ausdruckspflicht cannot bear an actor's actual expression. HyperNorm cards about sincere performance must become either authentic or staged, preferably with the same approved smile. Men in Black rehearsal notes intensify his anxious work; he cleans the mask's unseen inner surface as carefully as the front, in case somebody has to spend a whole evening behind it.

records.name: Frau Ursprungszustand
records.biography_en: A chipped cup gives Frau Ursprungszustand enough work to postpone the entire present. In HyperNorm she brushes cards about meaningful damage into intact or ruined piles, unable to admit a third condition called lived with. Hunky & Dory demand pristine recovery; she keeps one tiny chip untouched beneath the handle because her mother always knew her own cup by touch in the dark.

variant_notes.note_en: The brush can clean the tiny cup without having to erase its identifying chip.

records.name: Herr Geschmacksurteil
records.biography_en: Set the gavel down, and somebody might finish a sentence. Herr Geschmacksurteil therefore cradles it through the HyperNorm taste hearings, where the Men in Black appreciate his distinction between approved and mistaken. Cards about generous criticism receive particularly gentle verdicts. Lately he has begun resting the enormous wooden head on his own lap, discovering that judgement takes longer when its weight remains with the speaker.

records.name: Herr Zutrittszweifel
records.biography_en: The velvet rope in Herr Zutrittszweifel's hands marks a boundary even when nobody can say which side contains the exhibition. HyperNorm cards about inclusive limits are sorted into admitted or unsuitable. Hunky & Dory threaten to audit attendance, making every visitor alarming; he warms the brass ends in his palms so the next rejected guest will at least receive a courteous, comfortable obstacle.

records.name: Meister Stilljetzt
records.biography_en: Meister Stilljetzt uses an enormous gong to establish that silence is compulsory. In his HyperNorm class, cards about noisy peace are either serene or a disturbance, and beginners regularly fail by breathing honestly. The Men in Black value an orderly retreat; after everyone leaves he rests the felt mallet against the brass without striking, enjoying the only instruction he has not yet given aloud.

records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black retreat standards reward his impatient enforcement of calm.

records.name: Frau Gelassenheitsnachweis
records.biography_en: Frau Gelassenheitsnachweis squeezes a vast red stress ball while explaining that tension is a choice. HyperNorm cards about frightened courage must look either calm or unfit for public circulation. Hunky & Dory selected her reassuring manner, so she grins through every demonstration; she loosens her grip when a participant admits being scared and is startled by how much larger the room suddenly feels.

records.pressure_relation_en: Hunky & Dory's demand for reassurance traps her in a strained public smile.

variant_notes.note_en: The squeezed stress ball holds the tension her reassuring smile cannot acknowledge.

records.name: Herr Karmensaldo
records.biography_en: Herr Karmensaldo moves one abacus bead for each kindness and two whenever gratitude seems delayed. HyperNorm cards about unrewarded generosity must finish either in credit or in moral default. Men in Black balance reviews keep him awake; an anonymous neighbour once brought him soup, and he has left one bead halfway across ever since, unwilling to decide who should receive the interest.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Suppe steht weiter zwischen Soll und Haben.

records.name: Bruder Rückzugsleitung
records.biography_en: Bruder Rückzugsleitung carries a handbell to announce that nobody should make a sound. His HyperNorm retreat contains cards about sociable solitude, divided strictly into engaged or withdrawn. Hunky & Dory demand satisfied guests without extra staff; the oversized earplugs are meant for participants, but he sometimes holds them near his own head while imagining a break that needs no explanation or departure ceremony.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Rückzug bleibt personell vor Ort.

variant_notes.note_en: The tiny bell and oversized earplugs divide the silence he organises from the rest he needs.

records.name: Madame Kartenlage
records.biography_en: One blank card stays face down when Madame Kartenlage's visitor looks especially frightened. The Men in Black requested dependable reassurance from her HyperNorm consulting room, so her glass sphere normally supplies predictions that are either confirmed or misunderstood. Cards about fruitful uncertainty make that arrangement harder to explain. She does not announce the exception; an unexamined tomorrow seems to work better without another confident interpretation attached.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Zukunft erhielt ausnahmsweise keinen Befund.

variant_notes.note_en: Three blank cards and a glass sphere keep her futures available for considerate revision.

records.name: Herr Reingewissen
records.biography_en: Herr Reingewissen scrubs the ivory soap as fiercely as anything it might clean. Cards about compromised goodness enter his HyperNorm washroom as either pure or contaminated, with no allowance for useful contact. Hunky & Dory admire the discipline, and he aches to deserve it; he secretly saves the softened brush for a neighbour's fragile belongings, accepting a few fibres that will never look entirely proper again.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Bürste wurde durch Rücksicht etwas unrein.

variant_notes.note_en: The wooden brush wears down while the soap keeps receiving his demand for purity.

records.name: Frau Trendgewiss
records.biography_en: Frau Trendgewiss consults her portable weather vane indoors, where the prevailing direction is easier to arrange. Cards about pioneering conformity circulate through her HyperNorm forecast only as ahead or behind. Hunky & Dory commission optimistic trends, and she obliges with professional relief; when a draught catches the brass unexpectedly, she enjoys being surprised for one breath before correcting the report.

records.name: Herr Automatenvertrauen
records.biography_en: The clockwork robot never disagrees with Herr Automatenvertrauen, provided he remembers to wind it. His HyperNorm lectures confine cards about dependent autonomy to intelligent or obsolete examples. Men in Black sponsors prefer the demonstration without questions; he secretly repairs the toy's sticking foot by hand, then calls its new limp a personality because admitting affection would make the argument considerably less efficient.

records.name: Herr Späterleben
records.biography_en: Herr Späterleben's insulated flask preserves a future too precious to open today. He sorts HyperNorm cards about living with mortality into saved or wasted lives, postponing his own lunch to explain the distinction. Hunky & Dory require hopeful presentations; after each one he warms the flask between his tired hands, imagining that somebody in tomorrow might appreciate the care rather than the sales pitch.

records.name: Architektin Endlichgut
records.biography_en: A tiny crooked corner gives Architektin Endlichgut's thumb somewhere comfortable during difficult meetings. The Men in Black have not noticed it in her handheld model of a HyperNorm home. They prefer cards about imperfect shelter sorted into planned or failed, and she usually agrees. Yet her favourite part of the little house is becoming the one alteration no resident was formally supposed to need.

records.pressure_relation_en: Men in Black approval favours models without costly human complications.

records.name: Herr Vorratszukunft
records.biography_en: A sealed tin guarantees Herr Vorratszukunft that his most important meal has not yet been wasted. Cards about ordinary resilience are locked into catastrophe or complacency in his HyperNorm pantry. Hunky & Dory encourage readiness without asking whether he sleeps; he carries a tiny spoon for the emergency, but occasionally lends it to a neighbour's entirely uneventful pudding and feels reckless afterwards.

records.name: Herr Aufstiegsweg
records.biography_en: Herr Aufstiegsweg holds the folded ladder while explaining how easily others could climb. His HyperNorm advice divides cards about mutual dependence into rising or failing, ignoring whoever steadies the bottom. Men in Black mobility targets reward his promises; he worries that unfolding the little wooden steps will reveal their limit, so he volunteers to support a neighbour's awkward reach and calls it a consultation.

records.name: Herr Blätterstolz
records.biography_en: Herr Blätterstolz brushes his enormous croissant as though the smallest flake had applied for citizenship. The Men in Black want dependable portions, but pastry keeps teaching him otherwise; he catches loose crumbs in his collar and eats them privately, granting imperfect fragments a tenderness he finds difficult to extend across the counter.

records.name: Madame Schalenwert
records.biography_en: Madame Schalenwert presents an oversized pearl as if uncertainty were a premium ingredient. Her HyperNorm shell contains cards about costly emptiness, which she divides into exclusive or worthless experiences. Hunky & Dory admire the margin and request more mystery; she occasionally closes the shell before a nervous customer buys, giving them time to decide whether they wanted a pearl or merely permission to admire one.

records.biography_en: Three clean plates are enough for an inspection and never enough for a shift. Herr Spülbestand knows the distinction; the Men in Black visiting his HyperNorm station do not ask. He confines cards about necessary repetition to completed or failed, making his own useful work permanently suspect. records.name: Herr Ringwurst
records.biography_en: Herr Ringwurst enjoys a product whose beginning and end cannot be argued apart. Cards about open commitment enter his HyperNorm stall as either properly joined or broken promises. Hunky & Dory encourage his cheerful certainty, yet he remembers a customer who needed only half; he holds the sausage ring more loosely now, privately rehearsing how generosity might survive the terrible moment of cutting it.

records.biography_en: Frau Rezepttreue holds the carrot beside the cookbook until both seem to agree. records.biography_en: Hunky & Dory require alertness before Herr Koffeinvorbehalt feels capable of being a person. records.name: Herr Vorverzehr
records.biography_en: Before eating a tiny cake, Herr Vorverzehr must establish that it has already been enjoyed correctly. HyperNorm cards about imperfect presence are either captured or lost beneath his camera. The Men in Black want evidence of satisfaction, which he supplies enthusiastically; once a neighbour's laugh ruins the framing, he keeps that exposure and eats before taking another, surprised that the cake still tastes of something.

records.name: Frau Petri Geduld
records.biography_en: Frau Petri Geduld has landed an old boot and refuses to call the afternoon unsuccessful. HyperNorm cards about patient action become either a catch or a missed opportunity beneath her short rod. Hunky & Dory expect positive results; she rinses the boot as carefully as a fish, then wonders whether its unknown owner had an even worse day and whether finding it might count as useful work.

records.name: Herr Zähnungsgrad
records.biography_en: A child gave Herr Zähnungsgrad the damaged stamp that defeats his entire collection. The Men in Black praise his HyperNorm sorting, which recognises a distinction or declares a duplicate; cards about common uniqueness are a standing irritation. His oversized tweezers can handle every tiny difference except this one.
